what: Real ScreenSeekeR runs on a live macOS desktop (no mocks). `tjm-agent ground` = locate only, no click.
code: The four position/absent searches ran on the grounding code committed in da28d05 (before the location-aware result check added in 9b952a3). Images were re-rendered later from the saved raw screenshots and traces with improved annotations (8020b78); no search was re-run for them.
machine: Apple M2, 8 GB, macOS 26.3, built-in display 1710x1112 pt / 3420x2224 px (scale 2.0)
planner: claude-opus-5-5, effort=low (at da28d05 the result check also used low)
grounder: mlx-community/UI-Venus-1.5-2B-6bit (local, MLX), inputs downscaled to <=1280 px
images: Annotated full screenshots downscaled 2x for the repo. Yellow = candidate patches with Eq.1 scores, dots = grounded planner references, blue = verified leaf crop, red = final hit.

runs.condition: alias dragged to top-left by a person
runs.target: TextEdit application icon on the desktop

runs.condition: alias dragged to bottom-right (against the Dock) by a person
runs.target: TextEdit application icon on the desktop

runs.condition: alias dragged to screen centre (busy wallpaper) by a person
runs.target: TextEdit application icon on the desktop

runs.condition: target absent: must abstain, no click
runs.target: Blender application icon on the desktop

more.popup/: Live pop-up test on 9b952a3: icon covered -> not_found -> triage safe -> 'Later' grounded by label and clicked (fixture log: 'Later clicked') -> icon found -> post saved. See popup/summary.json.
more.full_run/: Final full run on 9b952a3: 10/10 posts byte-exact, 11 searches all found, 689 s. Sample traces: post 1, post 2 (both attempts: a notification banner changed the screen before the click, so the agent re-searched), post 10. Full summary.json included.
more.bonus/: Live bonus challenges (code at the commit that adds this folder): lookalike icons, 32/128 px icons, light and dark themes, 5/5 correct. See bonus/summary.json, including invalid runs that were excluded and why.
